items.title: 2.4 Graph of the Cube Root Function (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein square root function dekha jo sirf \(x \ge 0\) par chalta tha. Ab cube root function dekhenge, jo har real number par chalta hai. Kitab yahan bhi seedha misaal deti hai, is liye pehle buniyadi baat samajh lete hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Buniyadi cube root function \(y = \sqrt[3]{x}\) hai: \(\sqrt[3]{x}\) woh number hai jis ka cube \(x\) ho. Har real number ka bilkul ek real cube root hota hai, negative ka bhi: \(\sqrt[3]{8} = 2\), \(\sqrt[3]{-8} = -2\), \(\sqrt[3]{0} = 0\). Is liye is ka domain aur range dono tamaam real numbers hain.
\(y = \sqrt[3]{x - 1}\) mein andar wala "\(-1\)" poore graph ko ek unit daayen (right) sarka deta hai: \(y = \sqrt[3]{x}\) ka darmiyani point \((0, 0)\) ab \((1, 0)\) par aa jata hai. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: andar minus ho to graph daayen, andar plus ho to baayen; bilkul ulta lagta hai, magar \(x = 1\) rakh kar dekhiye ke andar zero kab banta hai.

blocks.title: Example 11
steps:
Given: cube root function \(y = \sqrt[3]{x - 1}\).
To find: is ka domain, range, table of values aur graph.
Method: pehle domain aur range tay karenge, phir \(x = -5\) se \(5\) tak table banayenge, points plot karenge aur hamwaar curve se jorenge.

Step 1: Domain aur range
Cube root function tamaam real numbers ke liye defined hai, kyun ke kisi bhi number (positive, negative ya zero) ka cube root hamesha real hota hai. Is liye diye gaye function ka domain tamaam real numbers hai, aur range bhi real numbers ka set hai.
Kyun: misal ke taur par \(\sqrt[3]{-8} = -2\), kyun ke \((-2)^{3} = (-2)(-2)(-2) = -8\). Square root mein negative number ka root real nahin hota (do same signs ka product hamesha positive), lekin cube mein teen factors hote hain, is liye negative ka cube negative aata hai. Aur har real \(y\) milti hai: \(y = \sqrt[3]{x - 1}\) se \(x = y^{3} + 1\), jo har \(y\) ke liye ek \(x\) de deta hai.

Step 2: Table of values
\[x = 1:\ y = \sqrt[3]{0} = 0\]
\[x = 2:\ y = \sqrt[3]{1} = 1\]
\[x = 0:\ y = \sqrt[3]{-1} = -1\]
\[x = 3:\ y = \sqrt[3]{2} \approx 1.3\]
\[x = -1:\ y = \sqrt[3]{-2} \approx -1.3\]
Baaqi values (neeche table mein) isi tarah calculator se nikaal kar ek decimal tak round ki gayi hain.
Kyun: jab \(x - 1\) perfect cube ho (\(0, 1, -1\)) to cube root pakka milta hai. Baaqi ke liye calculator chahiye. Ghor karein ke \(x = 3\) aur \(x = -1\) ki values sirf sign mein mukhtalif hain: graph \((1, 0)\) ke gird symmetric hai.

Step 3: Plot kar ke jorein
Table ke points lagayein aur unhein \((0, -1)\), \((1, 0)\) aur \((2, 1)\) se guzarte hamwaar curve se jorein (neeche table aur graph dekhiye).
Kyun: \(x = 1\) ke qareeb values sab se tezi se badalti hain (0 se 1 tak \(y\) poora 1 barhta hai), is liye curve \((1, 0)\) par sab se zyada seedha khara hai. Door jaa kar curve chapta hota jata hai, magar hamesha upar hi jata hai.

Tasdeeq:
Ek value ko cube kar ke check karte hain:
\[(-1.8)^{3} \approx -5.8\]
aur \(x - 1 = -5 - 1 = -6\). Farq sirf rounding ka hai (\(\sqrt[3]{-6} \approx -1.817\)), is liye value sahi hai. Isi tarah \(1.3^{3} \approx 2.2\), jo \(3 - 1 = 2\) ke qareeb hai.
blocks.answer: Domain: tamaam real numbers; range: tamaam real numbers. Graph table ke points se guzarta curve hai jo \(x\)-axis ko \((1, 0)\) par kaat'ta hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai (kitab ka sawal nahin): \(y = \sqrt[3]{x} + 2\).
Domain aur range: dono tamaam real numbers.
Points: \(x = -8\): \(-2 + 2 = 0\); \(x = -1\): \(-1 + 2 = 1\); \(x = 0\): \(2\); \(x = 1\): \(3\); \(x = 8\): \(4\).
Graph \(y = \sqrt[3]{x}\) wala hi hai, bas 2 unit upar; is ka darmiyani point \((0, 2)\) hai aur yeh \(x\)-axis ko \((-8, 0)\) par kaat'ta hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Square root aur cube root ke graphs mein sab se bara farq kya hai? (Jawab: square root ka graph sirf ek taraf, \(x \ge 0\) par, ek point se shuru hota hai; cube root ka graph dono taraf hamesha chalta rehta hai aur kahin shuru ya khatam nahin hota. Isi liye cube root ki range bhi poori real line hai.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(y = \sqrt[3]{x}\): domain aur range tamaam real numbers; negative ka cube root negative.
2. \(y = \sqrt[3]{x - h}\) asal graph ko \(h\) unit daayen le jata hai; \(x\)-axis ko \((h, 0)\) par kaat'ta hai.
3. Graph har jagah upar jata hai, darmiyan mein sab se seedha khara aur door ja kar chapta.
4. Pakke points ke liye aisi \(x\) lein jis se \(x - 1\) perfect cube bane (\(0, \pm 1, \pm 8\)).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Cube root ko square root jaisa samajh kar negative \(x\) chhor dena: \(\sqrt[3]{-2}\) real hai (\(\approx -1.26\)).
2. Minus ka sign gira dena: \(\sqrt[3]{-8} = -2\), \(2\) nahin.
3. Graph ko ulti taraf sarka dena: andar \(x - 1\) graph ko daayen le jata hai, baayen nahin.
4. Table mein negative values ke minus signs bhool jana; kitab ki print mein bhi yeh minus halke hain, ghor se parhein.
